{"response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"u7GFafn7NPHe_uMPjIbRoQI","candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // State tracking for the algorithm\n  // Using static variables to maintain state across calls without modifying the solver struct.\n  static uint64_t last_restarts_count = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_restart_conflicts = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_perturbation_conflicts = 0;\n  static double perturbation = 0.0;\n\n  // Detect if a restart occurred since the last check\n  uint64_t current_restarts = GET (restarts);\n  if (current_restarts \u003e last_restarts_count) {\n    last_restarts_count = current_restarts;\n    // Approximate the conflict count at the start of the current run\n    last_restart_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n  }\n\n  // Step 5: Perturb thresholds every 5000 conflicts\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003e last_perturbation_conflicts + 5000) {\n    last_perturbation_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n    // Generate random float in [-0.05, 0.05]\n    // kissat_pick_double returns [0, 1)\n    double r = kissat_pick_double (&solver-\u003erandom);\n    perturbation = (r * 0.1) - 0.05;\n  }\n\n  // Stable mode: Use standard Reluctant Doubling strategy\n  // The adaptive divergence strategy is designed for Focused mode\n  if (solver-\u003estable) {\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n  }\n\n  // Focused mode: Stabilized Adaptive Divergence Restarting\n\n  // Step 1 & 2: Calculate Divergence Ratio (Fast EMA / Slow EMA)\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n  double divergence_ratio = (slow \u003e 0.0) ? (fast / slow) : 1.0;\n\n  uint64_t conflicts_since = CONFLICTS - last_restart_conflicts;\n\n  // Apply perturbation to base thresholds\n  double t1 = 1.15 + perturbation;\n  double t2 = 0.85 + perturbation;\n\n  // Step 3: Forced Restart\n  // Condition: Divergence is high (\u003e 1.15 perturbed) AND \n  // we are past the stabilization window (100 conflicts)\n  if (divergence_ratio \u003e t1 && conflicts_since \u003e= 100) {\n    LOG (\"forced restart: divergence %.2f \u003e %.2f after %\" PRIu64 \" conflicts\", \n         divergence_ratio, t1, conflicts_since);\n    return true; // Bypass standard conflict limit\n  }\n\n  // Step 4: Restart Veto / Extension\n  // Condition: Divergence is low (\u003c 0.85 perturbed), indicating good search progress\n  if (divergence_ratio \u003c t2) {\n    // If we have reached the standard restart limit\n    if (CONFLICTS \u003e= solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts) {\n      // Increment the limit by the duration of the current run (effectively doubling allowance)\n      solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts += conflicts_since;\n      LOG (\"restart veto: divergence %.2f \u003c %.2f, extended limit to %\" PRIu64, \n           divergence_ratio, t2, solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts);\n      return false; // Do not restart yet\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Standard fallback: restart if standard limit reached\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003e= solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts) {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}],"role":"model"},"index":0}],"usageMetadata":{"thoughtsTokenCount":8855,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":6050,"modality":"TEXT"}],"totalTokenCount":15796,"promptTokenCount":6050,"candidatesTokenCount":891}},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
